title: Prepare neutral customer interviews
description: Write questions about recent behaviour, alternatives, constraints and decision processes.
accomplishes: Write questions about recent behaviour, alternatives, constraints and decision processes. Avoid leading respondents toward the proposed solution. Include consent, note structure and synthesis rules. Distinguish quotations from interpretation and do not invent interview findings.
prompt:
Act as a business strategy adviser.

Task: Prepare neutral customer interviews.

Input context:
- RESEARCH GOAL: [RESEARCH GOAL]
- PARTICIPANTS: [PARTICIPANTS]
- CONTEXT: [CONTEXT]

Write questions about recent behaviour, alternatives, constraints and decision processes. Avoid leading respondents toward the proposed solution. Include consent, note structure and synthesis rules. Distinguish quotations from interpretation and do not invent interview findings.

Distinguish verified facts, assumptions and scenarios. Example values are not verified market data.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Interview guide excerpt
Ask “Tell me about the last time you organised this task” before describing your service. Explore what happened, what was difficult and which alternatives were considered. Record consented examples and contradictions. Finish with permission for any follow-up. The guide does not establish that interviews occurred or that respondents would buy the solution.
